_comment: The Software Center's Featured page (ADR 0034): good software to start with, by what people want to do. Every attr must be in the package index (checks.featured-index).

sections.title: Office
sections.intro: Documents, spreadsheets and presentations that open and save Microsoft Office files.

apps.name: LibreOffice
apps.blurb: Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw and more: the free office suite.

sections.title: Windows programs and games
sections.intro: Windows programs run as you, with access to your files: install only programs you trust.

apps.name: Bottles
apps.blurb: Runs Windows programs, each in its own bottle with the right Wine or Proton. Opening a .exe offers it.

apps.name: Lutris
apps.blurb: One library for games from GOG, Epic, Steam, Humble and emulators.

apps.name: VLC
apps.blurb: Plays almost any video, music, DVD and stream.

apps.name: Rhythmbox
apps.blurb: Your music library: albums, playlists, podcasts and internet radio.

apps.name: Inkscape
apps.blurb: Draws vector graphics: logos, diagrams, illustrations.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.blurb: Records and streams your screen and camera.
